subject: Hiring prioritization: critical backfills, lateral shifts & QBR note
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: PeopleOps <peopleops@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Hiring prioritization: critical backfills, lateral shifts & QBR note

Team —

Attached is the headcount snapshot and the open-req inventory for our QBR prep. TL;DR: I think we need quick leadership decisions on three items so I can lock the QBR slides and instruct PeopleOps to either start fast-track recruiting or freeze reqs.

Quick summary / ask:
- Critical backfills: Infra engineer (REQ-114) and Platform TPM (REQ-121) — recommend approve and fast-track.
- Freeze: Internal tools PM (REQ-138) — low immediate impact; propose freeze through end of Q2.
- Lateral conversion: Convert Product Designer (REQ-132) hiring to lateral transfer option before opening external req.

Risks and mitigations:
- Infra capacity will be tight if we do both backfills simultaneously; option to extend a contractor (contractor ID: C-908) for 3 months as stopgap.
- If we freeze REQ-138 now, we can reallocate that budget to fast-track REQ-114.

Please reply with explicit Approve / Freeze / Defer for each item by EOD PST so I can finalize the QBR headcount slides.

Attachments: QBR_headcount_snapshot_Feb21.xlsx, open-req-inventory_Feb21.csv

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hiring prioritization: critical backfills, lateral shifts & QBR note

Ben —

Thanks for the snapshot. I agree with the high-level direction but want to flag a tradeoff before we commit budget:

- Approve REQ-114 (Infra eng) for fast-track — Approve.
- Approve REQ-121 (Platform TPM) — Tentative Approve but prefer we push one of the non-urgent infra initiatives to next quarter to free up onboarding bandwidth.
- Freeze REQ-138 (Internal tools PM) — Approve freeze.
- Lateral for REQ-132 (Product Designer) — Strong preference to attempt an internal lateral first; if no matches within two weeks, open external req.

Alternative: extend contractor C-908 for 8 weeks (cheaper and faster) instead of immediate FTE for infra. PeopleOps will need a procurement note to extend (cc'd).

Please mark items with: Approve / Approve w/condition / Freeze / Defer so PeopleOps can action.

On the QBR deck note — we should include headcount impact per OKR (revenue-facing hires vs platform).

- Soojin
Soojin Lee
VP, Product
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hiring prioritization: critical backfills, lateral shifts & QBR note

Ben / Team —

Echoing Soojin. A couple operational notes from infra perspective:

- If we fast-track REQ-114 and REQ-121 concurrently, our onboarding slots (bench + mentor capacity) are the gating factor. I estimate a realistic ramp if both start in March is +6 weeks to reach full productivity for infra-facing work.
- Contractor C-908 is already familiar with the relevant codebase; extending them 8–12 weeks buys time and reduces risk. Approve contractor extension as primary mitigation.

Proposal: Approve REQ-114 fast-track; Approve REQ-121 but start hire in late March; Freeze REQ-138; attempt lateral for REQ-132.

Questions for Ben: can we shift the expected start date for REQ-121 to March 29 to ease overlap? If yes I approve the overall plan.

— Vivek
VP, Engineering
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: PeopleOps <peopleops@redwood.com>, Recruiting (sarah@northstartalent.com)
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hiring prioritization: critical backfills, lateral shifts & QBR note

Folks —

Putting the above into an operational decision table to make it concrete (see below). I also attached fasttrack_guidance.pdf for PeopleOps.

> From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
> Subject: Hiring prioritization: critical backfills, lateral shifts & QBR note
> Date: Feb 21, 2027, 08:15 PST
>
> Team —
> Attached is the headcount snapshot and the open-req inventory for our QBR prep. TL;DR: I think we need quick leadership decisions on three items so I can lock the QBR slides and instruct PeopleOps to either start fast-track recruiting or freeze reqs.

Decision table (Jonas proposal):
- REQ-114 (Infra Eng) — Action: Approve fast-track; Start: Asap (target start 2027-03-08); Owner: Recruiting; Risk mitigant: Extend C-908 for 8 weeks.
- REQ-121 (Platform TPM) — Action: Approve deferred start; Target start 2027-03-29; Owner: Hiring manager; Condition: adjust onboarding schedule.
- REQ-138 (Internal tools PM) — Action: Freeze through 2027-06-30; Owner: Product; Rationale: deprioritize for Q2.
- REQ-132 (Product Designer) — Action: Internal lateral window 14 days; If no match, open external req (fast-track).

PeopleOps/Recruiting next steps:
- PeopleOps to open fast-track req for REQ-114 today and kick off contractor extension purchase order for C-908 (procurement ticket HR-4231).
- Recruiter (NorthStar) to prioritize REQ-114; Jonas to approve JD adjustments before EOD.

Attachments: fasttrack_guidance.pdf

If everyone OK with the decision table, Ben — please update the QBR_headcount_snapshot and I will add a single-slide summary for the exec QBR.

Jonas
Head of Talent Operations
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: PeopleOps <peopleops@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 16:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hiring prioritization: critical backfills, lateral shifts & QBR note

All —

Agree with the decision table. Approvals:
- REQ-114: APPROVED (fast-track).
- REQ-121: APPROVED with deferred start (2027-03-29).
- REQ-138: FREEZE through 2027-06-30.
- REQ-132: INTERNAL LATERAL WINDOW (14 days) — go.

Ben — please update the QBR slide and the headcount workbook with these decisions and share with Finance (cc CFO) before COB Monday. Jonas / PeopleOps: open the procurement ticket HR-4231 for contractor extension and start the fast-track req paperwork for REQ-114. Recruiting: please prioritize NorthStar on REQ-114.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
VP, Finance & Operations
Redwood Inference
